Name: Jonathan, Son of Shammah
Summary: Jonathan, son of Shammah the Hararite, was among David's thirty mighty men. He is distinct from Jonathan son of Shimea, David's nephew, who slew the six-fingered giant.
KeyStory: Jonathan son of Shammah the Hararite stood among David's thirty.
LifeLesson: Two Jonathans fought for David — a mighty man and a giant-killer.
